description: The mirror of iana-equivalence-preferred-catalogs: catalogs for the DEPRECATED side (yol, bh, mrd, shl) so that a request naming the preferred side (enm, bih, mgp, mrh) discriminates. Both directions are needed because an equivalence class is symmetric and an implementation that mapped only deprecated->preferred would pass the other fixture entirely. Fallback fr, instance en, split for the same reason.
